overview: As an operator, I can use the new feature flow and complete the intended task.
goals: Provide a clear operator flow for the new feature
Allow operators to complete the intended task end-to-end
Ensure success and failure states are visible and recoverable
nonGoals: Changing authorization policy outside this feature flow
Automating operator decisions that require manual confirmation
successMetrics: Operators can complete the feature flow without manual backend intervention
Validation errors are surfaced with actionable guidance
The flow handles expected failure paths without data loss
openQuestions: What exact role permissions are required to access the feature flow?
What is the target completion time threshold for the intended task?
Are there audit requirements for each step transition in the flow?

stories.title: Expose entry point for the new feature flow
stories.description: As an operator, I can locate and open the new feature flow from the primary interface so I can begin the intended task.
acceptanceCriteria: A visible entry point for the feature flow is present in the operator interface.
Selecting the entry point opens the first step of the flow.
If the operator lacks access, the system shows an explicit access-denied state.

stories.title: Collect required inputs with inline validation
stories.description: As an operator, I can provide all required inputs and receive validation feedback before continuing, so invalid submissions are prevented.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid or missing inputs block progression and show field-level messages.
Valid inputs allow progression to the next step without errors.

stories.title: Execute the intended task through the flow
stories.description: As an operator, I can submit the flow and trigger the intended task so the feature performs its core operation.
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting from the final step triggers task execution exactly once.
A success response includes a clear confirmation indicator.
Execution failures return an actionable error state without corrupting prior inputs.

stories.title: Show progress and completion status
stories.description: As an operator, I can see current progress and final completion state so I know whether the intended task finished.
acceptanceCriteria: The flow displays step progress while the task is in progress.
On completion, the interface shows a definitive success or failure status.
Status updates remain visible after page refresh or reopen.

stories.title: Support safe retry after recoverable failure
stories.description: As an operator, I can retry the flow after recoverable errors so I can complete the intended task without starting from scratch unnecessarily.
acceptanceCriteria: Recoverable failures present a retry action.
Retry preserves valid previously entered data where safe.
Retry attempts are recorded with outcome for operator traceability.
